sources.title: PCI Express Advanced Error Reporting
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: TLB reach：頁面粒度與工作視窗的適配
related.titleEn: TLB reach: matching translation granularity to the working window
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付原始與分組報告、拓撲關聯、缺報與重送測例及不確定關聯清單；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver raw and grouped reports, topology relations, missing-report and retransmission tests, and uncertain correlations. Explain the distinction between a reporting component, a requesting component and an established cause. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立頁面大小、entry 數、工作視窗與存取跨度表；將實際處理器資料欄留為未量測，避免套用教學容量。
related.differenceEn: Build a table of page size, entry count, working-window size and access stride. Mark real-processor fields as unmeasured so the hypothetical entry counts cannot be mistaken for discovered hardware properties.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學紀錄中每個 incident_id 恰有三筆不同層級報告；唯一事故數等於報告數除以三，但實作須依鍵去重而非盲目除法；名義十二筆報告對應四個事件；變更十五筆對應五個；每筆帶 requester、reporter、severity 與 incident_id；名義式 12/3 = 4 incidents；變更式 15/3 = 5 incidents。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

理想完全相聯且同頁面大小的 reach 為 entry_count*page_size；比較工作視窗時必須使用相同二進位單位；假設兩個獨立配置都可使用 64 個對應頁面大小的 entry；名義頁面 2 MiB，變更 4 KiB；名義式 64*2 = 128 MiB；變更式 64*4/1024 = 0.25 MiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Each synthetic incident has exactly three reports at different levels. The arithmetic count is reports divided by three, while a robust implementation must deduplicate incident keys instead of assuming this multiplicity in real logs. Twelve nominal reports represent four incidents; fifteen changed reports represent five. Each row includes requester, reporter, severity and incident_id, with invented stable correlation identifiers. Nominal 12/3 = 4 incidents; changed 15/3 = 5 incidents. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Under a fully associative, single-page-size idealization, reach equals entry count times page size. Use consistent binary units and keep this capacity bound distinct from measured miss behavior. Assume two hypothetical configurations each provide 64 entries for the relevant page size. Pages change from 2 MiB to 4 KiB; this does not assert any real processor has identical capacities for both sizes. Nominal 64*2 = 128 MiB; changed 64*4/1024 = 0.25 MiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Linux bonding：故障偵測延遲與黑洞暴露
related.titleEn: Linux bonding: detection delay and blackhole exposure
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付原始與分組報告、拓撲關聯、缺報與重送測例及不確定關聯清單；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver raw and grouped reports, topology relations, missing-report and retransmission tests, and uncertain correlations. Explain the distinction between a reporting component, a requesting component and an established cause. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 時間線分故障發生、偵測、切換、可用恢復；把載波訊號與探測回應列成不同觀察。
related.differenceEn: Build a timeline with failure onset, detection, switching and restored usability. Record carrier signals separately from probe responses so the evidence describes which failure class the monitor can actually observe.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學紀錄中每個 incident_id 恰有三筆不同層級報告；唯一事故數等於報告數除以三，但實作須依鍵去重而非盲目除法；名義十二筆報告對應四個事件；變更十五筆對應五個；每筆帶 requester、reporter、severity 與 incident_id；名義式 12/3 = 4 incidents；變更式 15/3 = 5 incidents。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

固定供給且完全黑洞的模型中，暴露封包量為封包率乘偵測延遲；此量不等於最終不可恢復的應用資料；供給率每秒 2000 包；偵測延遲名義 0.3 秒、變更 0.05 秒；切換後立即恢復是教學假設；名義式 2000*0.3 = 600 packets exposed；變更式 2000*0.05 = 100 packets exposed。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Each synthetic incident has exactly three reports at different levels. The arithmetic count is reports divided by three, while a robust implementation must deduplicate incident keys instead of assuming this multiplicity in real logs. Twelve nominal reports represent four incidents; fifteen changed reports represent five. Each row includes requester, reporter, severity and incident_id, with invented stable correlation identifiers. Nominal 12/3 = 4 incidents; changed 15/3 = 5 incidents. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Under constant offered rate and a complete blackhole, exposed packets equal packet rate times detection delay. This is not necessarily permanently lost application data because retries and transport recovery are separate. Offer 2000 packets per second. Detection delay changes from 0.3 to 0.05 seconds, with immediate recovery after detection assumed for the fixture rather than asserted for real bonding behavior. Nominal 2000*0.3 = 600 packets exposed; changed 2000*0.05 = 100 packets exposed. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
